purpose: Teach: 明け方/何せ/とっさ/一々/断じて/どっぷり/浸っ/ふしぎ

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんは明け方にお散歩なさるのよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad takes his walk at dawn, you know.
lines.style: Warm observational tone. Slight nostalgic softness as she mentions her husband's routine. Speaking gently, as if sharing a small family detail she's fondly noticed.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、何せお祖父ちゃんは八十歳だからね、すごいよ
lines.en: Mom, but Grandpa is eighty years old — that's amazing!
lines.style: Bright, admiring energy in the opening. Quick uptake on the fact. Genuine wonder in his voice, not performed. Small boy registering something impressive about the adults around him.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、とっさにママの手を握ってくれて嬉しかったわ
lines.en: Sho, I was so glad when you grabbed my hand just now.
lines.style: Soft, genuine warmth. A quiet moment of maternal tenderness — not gushing, but sincere. Slight catch in her voice like she's letting herself feel something she usually keeps private.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お祖父ちゃんに一々お礼を言ったよ
lines.en: Mom, I thanked Grandpa for everything he did.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact pride in what he did. No boasting — just a child stating a fact about his own good behavior. Small, quiet confidence.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖父ちゃんは断じてうそをつかない方ね
lines.en: Sho, Grandpa is the kind of person who never lies.
lines.style: Reflective, almost teaching him something. Steady certainty in her tone. She's naming something true about the grandfather — not as praise, but as fact he should know.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お絵描きにどっぷりはまってるよ
lines.en: Mom, I'm really into drawing right now.
lines.style: Eager, almost breathless with the topic shift. Excitement bubbling through — he's caught up in something. Immediate, present-tense energy, like he's just remembered what he really wants to talk about.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが温泉に浸ってらしたの、想像できる?
lines.en: Sho, can you imagine your dad soaking in a hot spring?
lines.style: Playful curiosity in her question. Gentle, inviting him to picture something cozy. Her tone suggests she finds it charming to imagine — almost conspiratorial, like they're sharing a small family joke.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お絵描きが上手って言われてふしぎな気持ちだったよ
lines.en: Mom, when people said I was good at drawing, it gave me a strange feeling.
lines.style: Hesitant, introspective. He's turning something over in his mind — praise made him unsettled in a way he's still figuring out. Quieter than before. Thoughtful, not quite sorting it yet.
